adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the result of safeParse which is `{ success, data, error }` envelope. In GoogleCalendarService line 97, `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` stores this envelope directly. Then `await prisma.credential.update({ where: { id: credential.id }, data: { key } })` saves the envelope to the database. On next service construction, `googleCredentialSchema.parse(credential.key)` at line 78 will fail because it expects the actual credential shape, not the safeParse wrapper. The finding correctly identifies this bug - the code should use `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...).data` instead of the full return value.
